userListDescription: Search loaded users, then open a profile to review access.
noMatchesDescription: Try a different search or clear the query to see all users.
searchLoadedHint: Load the next page to expand search results.
editUserDescription: Update {name}'s name and phone number. The email address cannot be changed.
discardUserDescription: Unsaved changes to the name or phone number will be lost if discarded.
deleteUserDescription: This user will be removed from the account. Check the name above before continuing.
changeRoleDescription: You are changing {name}'s access by assigning a new role. You can only assign roles below your level to users whose level is also lower than yours.
roleChangeUnavailable: No roles are available to assign to this user.
errorInvalidUserProfile: Enter a name. Phone numbers can be up to 20 characters.
restrictedDescription: The user list is available to admins and owners.
